messages:
Tara N: Quick postmortem follow-up from the model-registry + cloud-auth outage. I sketched a small remediation plan and a short-term drill cadence. Need owners, blockers, and ETA for each item.
Ben S: Thanks Tara. Can you drop the list here so we can triage?
Tara N: Sure — TL;DR: 1) auth backoff & provider-fanout (owner: Kofi), 2) registry failover rehearsals + schema-checks (owner: Lena), 3) onboarding smoke-tests + metrics (owner: Lena), 4) incident runbook update & rotation (owner: Tara).
Kofi A: I can take #1. My plan: implement provider-fanout with per-provider circuit breakers + local cache. PoC by 2026-04-06, roll to staging 2026-04-15. Need a security sign-off for cache design.
Lena R: Taking #2 and #3. For failover rehearsals I'll coordinate with infra for a maintenance window — target first drill 2026-04-09. For onboarding smoke-tests, I'll add a webhook-based check in the registry CI by 2026-04-05.
Ben S: Sounds good. A couple notes: - make the smoke-tests lightweight (no large model downloads) - add a metric that tracks registry 'validation latency' so we can detect slowdowns earlier.
Tara N: Noted. I also want to propose an "owner rotation": primary + secondary for each action; rotate every 6 weeks so we don't have single-person bottlenecks. Agree?
Kofi A: Agree with rotation. I'll add a secondary from infra for the cache work.
Lena R: Agree too. For #2 secondary I'd like QA to be the backup for drills.
Ben S: I'll open the PR to add a "Dependencies" section in the postmortem that includes a heatmap and weekly signal checks. I'll also add a short list of recurring patterns we saw (auth spikes at midnight deploys, registry write stalling during GC).
Tara N: Great. Incident board entries: A) fanout-cache (#4987) owner Kofi, due 2026-04-15, B) failover-drill (#4988) owner Lena, due 2026-04-09, C) onboarding-smoke (#4989) owner Lena, due 2026-04-05, D) postmortem-deps-section (#4990) owner Ben, due 2026-04-03.
incident-bot: Reminder: add test plans to each board item and tag @security for cache design review.
Kofi A: Question on cache TTL: do we set a conservative 30s TTL initially? Would prefer 60s for stability. Thoughts?
Ben S: Start conservative—30s + adaptive refresh if we see higher miss rates. Also ensure tokens are evicted on rotate events.
Lena R: For failover drills let's simulate both read-only and full-primary promotion. I'll draft scenarios and post them to the task.
Tara N: I'm scheduling a 25-min 'deps resilience' weekly check for the next 6 weeks to close these items. Proposed Wednesdays 9:30am PT — can everyone make it?
Kofi A: Wednesday works.
Ben S: I can do Wednesdays.
Lena R: Works for me.
Tara N: Calendar invite sent. Action items: owners please add a 3-bullet test plan by EOD Thursday. If you hit blockers (quota, infra window, sec review), flag ASAP here.
Kofi A: Will add test plan + security ping.
Lena R: Adding drill runbook and onboarding smoke test steps.
Ben S: PR for postmortem deps-section opened: https://redwood.internal/pulls/789 — please review.
incident-bot: Board items created: #4987 #4988 #4989 #4990. Weekly reminders scheduled.
Tara N: Closing — thanks team. We'll reconvene after first drill and update the incident notes with measured latencies and remediation timelines. :white_check_mark:
